blocks.title: How to use these lists
bullets: Nouns have their article (el / la). Learn them together: el billete, la maleta.
Cover one column and test yourself in both directions, then write sentences with the preterite, imperfect and perfect you learnt in this level.
All words are Spain Spanish. The table in section 14 shows where Latin America differs.
Brackets after a verb show a stem change in the present tense: recordar (ue) gives recuerdo.

items: el billete de ida y vuelta

blocks.title: Menú del día
blocks.text: Most Spanish restaurants offer a menú del día at lunchtime: a starter, a main course, a dessert or coffee, bread and a drink for a fixed price (often 10 to 15 euros). Asking for la cuenta is normal: waiters do not bring it unless you ask.

blocks.title: oreja or oído?
blocks.text: Dutch oor has two Spanish words: la oreja is the outside of the ear, el oído is the inner ear and the sense of hearing. Me duele el oído (my ear hurts, inside), Tiene las orejas grandes (he has big ears).
To say that something hurts, use doler with an indirect pronoun, like gustar: Me duele la cabeza. Me duelen los pies. Or: Tengo dolor de cabeza.

English
Example
rows: En enero nieva en la sierra.

items: Jobs do not take an article after ser: Soy ingeniero industrial. Mi madre es médica. With an adjective you do use it: Es un buen ingeniero.
Many jobs have a feminine form in -a (la médica, la abogada, la ingeniera); nouns in -ista and -e stay the same (el / la dentista, el / la estudiante).

blocks.title: jugar a, tocar
blocks.text: Sports and games take jugar a (jugar al tenis, jugar a las cartas), musical instruments take tocar (tocar el piano).

blocks.title: Spain: aprobar and suspender
blocks.text: In Spain you aprobar (pass) or suspender (fail) an exam, and a pass mark is a cinco out of ten. He suspendido matemáticas = I failed maths. In some Latin American countries reprobar is used for failing.
This course uses Spain Spanish. You will meet the words in the right-hand column in films, series and apps from Latin America.
